title: Deliver Coal to Londstone Power Station
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Coal** delivered to **Londstone Power Station** (industry id 18, near tile 141,32).

A likely supplier is **Londstone Coal Mine** (industry id 22, near tile 123,39); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **45,000 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
